purpose: Resolve the architecture and regularization uncertainty for the sole evidence-supported follow-up: context treatment is beneficial overall, but the prior explicit user-by-tab categorical interaction reduced primary. Need literature that distinguishes robust low-cardinality context conditioning from high-cardinality user-context memorization while preserving within-user ranking.
query: Context-aware learning-to-rank for recommender systems: evidence and implementation guidance for low-cardinality request-context (tab, hour, weekday) interactions or context-conditioned ranking under temporal splits; compare explicit cross features, shared embeddings, and regularization when user-by-context crosses overfit.

purpose: Resolve whether a bounded objective change can plausibly address the observed gap between acceptable GAUC and weak nDCG@5 in material tabs without changing the fixed evaluation or using forbidden outcome features. The current pairwise K=4 objective plateaued, so evidence is needed before spending an experiment on a top-k-aligned loss or sampling scheme.
query: Top-k learning-to-rank objectives for implicit-feedback recommendation with within-user candidate sets: compare pairwise logistic/RankNet negative sampling against listwise or top-k-weighted objectives, including robustness to sparse positives and temporal holdout evaluation.
